title: Record the cut coefficient of register 359
body:
## Summary
- Starting from `1`, the scalar coefficient of register 359 is `-1` after event 9545, `0` after event 9549, and `1` after event 24433.
- Immediately before the fault the coefficient is `1`, so the literal amplitude `256` is unchanged. The data register contributes `0`, and register 39 holds `-4`.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The restoring source is not traced.
